text_block_list.text:
"A day in February. With Valentine's Day 
only a few days away, I found myself 
having a staring contest with my computer 
screen."
choice_data_list:
I see, so in Hong Kong it's bouquets 
rather than chocolates.

I see, so in Hong Kong bouquets are 
preferred over chocolates.

text_block_list.text:
Having entered the Senior Year, Satono 
Crown is dedicating herself to training 
even more intensely.

To show appreciation for all her hard 
work, a plan was currently underway to 
celebrate Valentine's Day for her in true 
"Hong Kong style."
choice_data_list:
(Apparently in Hong Kong it's a day to 
show affection, but...)

text_block_list.text:
I should express my gratitude for her hard 
work. Tell her that seeing her do her best 
always gives me energy—

I should express my gratitude for her hard 
work. Tell her that seeing her do her best 
always gives me energy—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Kura-chan! ...Wait, what happened 
to you!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Zǎoshang! It's from Trainer. It was on the 
desk when I arrived.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh, from you, Trainer? Why, why? Is it 
some kind of celebration?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That's not it, Kita-chan. Look, 
Valentine's, Valentine's♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I heard that in Hong Kong, it's pretty 
common to send bouquets to someone's 
workplace!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, is that right! That sounds kinda 
grown-up~."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you looked that up and got it 
just for Kura-chan! ...Hey, hey, what does 
the card say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Um... "To Satono Crown. In gratitude for 
all your hard work every day, I give you 
this."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"She told me, 'Let's go out for a feast 
today.' Hehe, she really spoils me."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —I cannot afford to lose this.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan & Dia
text_block_list.text: Huh, can't lose?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I got a message saying the order from 
the other day is finished, right? All 
right!"

“—Today, using Valentine's Day as an 
excuse, I had intended to treat the 
hardworking Satono Crown, but...”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hao! My assessment was right on the mark♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You look wonderful, Trainer! That suit 
suits you so well.
choice_data_list:
Geez, when did you even have this 
tailored?
Jeez, when did you get this tailored?

text_block_list.text:
I stroke the terrifyingly comfortable suit 
wrapped around me. ...Before coming here, 
she said "This is my payback" and made me 
change into it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret, a secret! Though that's 
coming more from Satono than from me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I actually wanted to confess first, you 
know? And yet—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Mom told me to pick a present that's a 
bit more fitting for a student, 
naturally."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's why it's starting from Satono.

That just goes to show how much is 
expected of me—and by extension, Satono 
Crown.
choice_data_list:
...Thank you. I'll receive it with 
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, please do! ...A-N-D then!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And here's my present to you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer!

I hastily reached out and took the bouquet 
from Satono Crown. But this was...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Does it look the same as the one sent to 
me?

My shoulders flinch with a start. 
...Indeed. That lush, blooming bouquet was 
identical to the one I had sent her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Honestly, you're far too easy to 
read.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, okay? The bouquet you gave 
me is decorated nicely in my room."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Besides... are you sure those are really 
the same bouquet?

Prompted by those words, I looked at the 
bouquet once more—and gasped.

Just when on earth did it get switched? 
The bouquet that had been so vividly 
colorful moments ago had completely 
transformed, all while keeping its beauty 
intact!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It's magic! Well? Were you surprised?♪
choice_data_list:
"Surprised" doesn't even begin to describe 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I wanted to leave a vivid 
impression in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Those are my true feelings, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"For today's celebration, for everything 
up until now, ...and for everything yet to 
come."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hao do ze nei. May my never-ending 
gratitude reach you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Once again... Happy Valentine's Day, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Once again... Happy Valentine's Day, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—The food was wonderful! Thank you so much 
for the invitation today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've had so much fun all day! This'll be a 
lifelong memory.

Relieved, I nod back at her smile, and 
lift up my own bouquet of dried flowers.
choice_data_list:
I'll cherish it for the rest of my life, 
too.

I'll cherish it for the rest of my life, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
choice_data_list: Well then, shall we head home?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, you're right! Let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...That was a surprise~.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Grateful, I'm so grateful. ...Agh, geez! 
I know what Trainer is trying to do, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Saying you'll "treasure it for a lifetime" 
is just unfair, isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(February 14th. Valentine's Day —in Hong 
Kong, "Lover's Day." A day to show love to 
your partner.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm coming right now, jeez!
